# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/blocks

List issues that are blocked by this issue (issues this issue blocks)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-211`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []*api.Issue

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | issue ID |
| `index` | int64 | issue index |
| `title` | string | issue title |
| `state` | string | open/closed |

- **404** — Issue not found or no read permission
